title: Comparison of three elements (In, Sn, and Sb) in the same period as catalysts in the ring-opening polymerization of L-lactide: from amorphous to semicrystalline polyesters
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34733-34745

This work explores the effect of three p-block elements (In, Sn, and Sb) in the same period of the periodic table as catalysts in the ring-opening polymerization of l-lactide.
